crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.name: Crystal Nova
crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.description: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement and attack rate in the targeted area.
crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.lore: The air temperature around Rylai drops rapidly, chilling all around her to the core.
crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.note0: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.

crystal_maiden_frostbite.name: Frostbite
crystal_maiden_frostbite.description: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time.
crystal_maiden_frostbite.lore: Rylai channels winds from the Blueheart Glacier, imprisoning attackers in thick blocks of ice.

crystal_maiden_arcane_aura.name: Arcane Aura
crystal_maiden_arcane_aura.lore: Cold temperatures promote the essence of magic, causing Rylai's presence to allow spell usage in abundance.

crystal_maiden_freezing_field.name: Freezing Field
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.description: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Grants bonus armor while channeling. Lasts %abilitychanneltime% seconds.
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.lore: Once the place of her exile, Icewrack has become an anchor for Rylai's frigid onslaught.
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.note0: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts %slow_duration% second).

dragon_knight_breathe_fire.name: Breathe Fire
dragon_knight_breathe_fire.description:
Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.

While in Dragon Form, applies the corresponding debuff from Corrosive Breath and Frost Breath when in those forms.
dragon_knight_breathe_fire.lore: Knight Davion's breath has become that of the mighty Eldwurm Slyrak, remembered for burning numerous other knights to a crisp.
dragon_knight_breathe_fire.note0: Hits creatures at a slightly greater distance.

dragon_knight_dragon_tail.name: Dragon Tail
dragon_knight_dragon_tail.description: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit in melee range with his shield, stunning it while dealing minor damage.  When in Elder Dragon Form, the cast range increases to %dragon_cast_range%.
dragon_knight_dragon_tail.lore: Davion's combination of dragon talents and knightly skills makes him a vicious opponent in melee combat.

dragon_knight_dragon_blood.name: Dragon Blood
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.description: The life blood of the Dragon improves health regeneration and strengthens armor.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.lore: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.

dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.name: Elder Dragon Form
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.description: The hero transforms into a powerful ancient dragon, increasing his movement speed, attack damage and the range of Dragon Tail.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.lore: The power of the ancient dragon that lies dormant within Davion is unleashed, combining the power of a legendary knight with the power of a legendary dragon.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.note0: The damage from poison attacks is lethal.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.note1: The cooldown of some items depends on what type of attack the hero had when using them.

omniknight_purification.name: Purification
omniknight_purification.description: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.
omniknight_purification.lore: Priests of the Omniscience are adept at removing impurities from fellow warriors.

omniknight_martyr.name: Repel
omniknight_martyr.description: Grants Debuff Immunity to the target, as well as bonus Strength and HP Regen based on the amount of Debuffs on them.
omniknight_martyr.lore: The All Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friend.

omniknight_hammer_of_purity.name: Hammer of Purity
omniknight_hammer_of_purity.description: Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.
omniknight_hammer_of_purity.2_custom_description: Omniknight fires his hammer to a target to deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slows the target.

omniknight_guardian_angel.name: Guardian Angel
omniknight_guardian_angel.description: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage.
omniknight_guardian_angel.lore: The All Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friend.

lone_druid_spirit_bear.name: Summon Spirit Bear
lone_druid_spirit_bear.description: Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion. If the bear moves %distance_silence% distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack. \nSpirit Bear has the Savage Roar and Entangling Claws abilities.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.lore: Sylla's lifelong companion is symbiotic with his spirit and heart, coming to aid him in any time of need.

lone_druid_spirit_link.name: Spirit Link
lone_druid_spirit_link.description: Aura of increased Attack Speed and lifesteal for the owner and all creatures they control.
lone_druid_spirit_link.lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.

lone_druid_savage_roar.name: Savage Roar
lone_druid_savage_roar.description: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee in terror. Their movement speed is increased.
lone_druid_savage_roar.note0: Cooldown of the hero and the bear is the same.
lone_druid_savage_roar.lore: Sylla studies and masters the arts of the lost Bear Clan, enhancing his attunement with the wild.

lone_druid_true_form.name: True Form
lone_druid_true_form.description: Lone Druid learns to morph himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining increased bonus armor and health.
lone_druid_true_form.lore: The mighty bear is the king of the forest, possessing the throne through raw power.

windranger_shackleshot.name: Shackleshot
windranger_shackleshot.description: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
windranger_shackleshot.lore: Windranger's variety of bow skills includes an arrow with thick ropes attached to encumber any escaping target.
windranger_shackleshot.note0: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
windranger_shackleshot.note1: Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.

windranger_powershot.name: Powershot
windranger_powershot.description: Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages enemies along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage is reduced.
windranger_powershot.lore: During her early years of training, Lyralei learned to fire powerful arrows that cleaved even trees to reach their targets.
windranger_powershot.note0: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.

windranger_windrun.name: Windrun
windranger_windrun.description: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks, while slowing movement of nearby enemies.
windranger_windrun.lore: Lyralei enchants gusts of winds to fight incoming attacks.

windranger_focusfire.name: Focus Fire
windranger_focusfire.description: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
windranger_focusfire.lore: Lyralei's ability to bombard opponents with a flurry of arrows is unparalleled - even at the expense of accuracy.
windranger_focusfire.note0: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
windranger_focusfire.whirlwind_description: The hero makes a fixed number of attacks every second against random enemies in the attack radius (primarily heroes). The same enemy can only be targeted every 4 attacks.

drow_ranger_frost_arrows.name: Frost Arrows
drow_ranger_frost_arrows.description: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.
drow_ranger_frost_arrows.lore: Ice-encased arrows pierce the silence, chilling their victims to the core.
drow_ranger_frost_arrows.note0: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.

drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.name: Gust
drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.description: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow. Drow Gains Movement Speed for the same duration.
drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.lore: Traxex is rather fond of the tranquility of physical combat, calling on her Drow heritage to end the incantations of opposing magi.

drow_ranger_multishot.name: Multishot
drow_ranger_multishot.description: Channeling. Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying longer duration Frost Arrows.
drow_ranger_multishot.lore: In the ranger's youth, learning to fire multiple arrows at once was considered a distracting frivolity. In the war of the Ancients, such technique has become strange necessity.
drow_ranger_multishot.2_custom_description: Channeling. Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying longer duration Frost Arrows.
drow_ranger_multishot.2_custom_lore: In the ranger's youth, learning to fire multiple arrows at once was considered a distracting frivolity. In the war of the Ancients, such technique has become strange necessity.

drow_ranger_marksmanship.name: Marksmanship
drow_ranger_marksmanship.description: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. Grants Drow bonus agility. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within %disable_range% range.
drow_ranger_marksmanship.lore: The Drow Ranger is the epitome of archery prowess.

witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.name: Paralyzing Cask
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.description: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.lore: The Witch Doctor recycles the bones of fallen friends and foes, using the powder as part of his arsenal of charms and alchemy.
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.note0: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.

witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.name: Voodoo Restoration
witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.description: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units and damaging enemies, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.lore: Zharvakko's hocus pocus is not limited only to hexxing his opponents and is quite adept at curing ailments.
witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.note0: Healing/Damage is done in %heal_interval% second intervals.

witch_doctor_maledict.name: Maledict
witch_doctor_maledict.description: Curses all enemy Heroes in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
witch_doctor_maledict.lore: Certain voodoo magics can make an enemy regret engaging the Witch Doctor.
witch_doctor_maledict.note0: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.

witch_doctor_death_ward.name: Death Ward
witch_doctor_death_ward.description: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
witch_doctor_death_ward.note0: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
witch_doctor_death_ward.note1: The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
witch_doctor_death_ward.note2: Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.
witch_doctor_death_ward.lore: Witch Doctor performs a ritualistic dance, one that haunts the dreams of those who live to recount it.

shadow_fiend_frenzy.description: The hero increases movement and attack speed for %duration% seconds. During this effect, the maximum souls from Necromastery increase by %soul_cost%, but at the end the owner loses the same amount of souls.
shadow_fiend_frenzy.note0: Cannot be activated if there are not enough souls.

shadow_fiend_dark_lord.name: Presence of the Dark Lord
shadow_fiend_dark_lord.description: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies. Every enemy hero killed nearby further improves armor reduction by %bonus_armor_per_stack% for %kill_buff_duration%s.
shadow_fiend_dark_lord.lore: Even being near Nevermore eats away at one's soul.

shadow_fiend_requiem.name: Requiem of Souls
shadow_fiend_requiem.description:
Shadow Fiend gathers his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery. 

 Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
shadow_fiend_requiem.lore: The captured souls of those past slain are released to ravage their former allies.
shadow_fiend_requiem.note0: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% souls in his possession.
shadow_fiend_requiem.note1: Fear and movement slow do not apply when if the Requiem was released on death.

shadow_fiend_necromastery.name: Necromastery
shadow_fiend_necromastery.description: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining bonus damage. On death, he releases 40% of them from bondage.
shadow_fiend_necromastery.lore: Harvested souls swirl in and out of the Abysm, empowering the Shadow Fiend to increase the size of his collection.

earthshaker_fissure.name: Fissure
earthshaker_fissure.description: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
earthshaker_fissure.lore: The Nishian totem splits the world to its core with tectonic force.
earthshaker_fissure.2_custom_description: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
earthshaker_fissure.2_custom_lore: The Nishian totem splits the world to its core with tectonic force.

earthshaker_enchant_totem.name: Enchant Totem
earthshaker_enchant_totem.description: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have %bonus_attack_range% bonus attack range on the next attack.
earthshaker_enchant_totem.lore: Raigor's gorilla strength can destroy mountains.
earthshaker_enchant_totem.note0: Bonus damage is based on base damage.

earthshaker_aftershock.name: Aftershock
earthshaker_aftershock.description: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
earthshaker_aftershock.lore: The earth trembles beneath the mighty footsteps of Raigor.
earthshaker_aftershock.note0: Using items does not trigger Aftershock.

earthshaker_echo_slam.name: Echo Slam
earthshaker_echo_slam.description: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units.  Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.
earthshaker_echo_slam.lore: Tectonic plates crack, mountains fold, and foes are crushed by the Echo Slam.

anti-mage_mana_break.name: Mana Break
anti-mage_mana_break.description: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt. Enemies with no mana left are temporarily slowed.
anti-mage_mana_break.lore: A modified technique of the Turstarkuri monks' peaceful ways is to turn magical energies on their owner.
anti-mage_mana_break.note0: Mana Break has %illusion_percentage%%% effect if caused by illusions.

anti-mage_blink.name: Blink
anti-mage_blink.description: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
anti-mage_blink.lore: In his encounter with the Dead Gods, Anti-Mage learned the value of being elusive.
anti-mage_blink.note0: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.

anti-mage_counterspell.name: Counterspell
anti-mage_counterspell.description: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks any targeted spells.
anti-mage_counterspell.lore: With the proper focus, Anti-Mage turns innate resistance into calculated retaliation.

anti-mage_mana_void.name: Mana Void
anti-mage_mana_void.description: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.
anti-mage_mana_void.lore: After bringing enemies to their knees, Anti-Mage punishes them for their use of the arcane arts.
anti-mage_mana_void.note0: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.

tidehunter_gush.name: Gush
tidehunter_gush.description: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
tidehunter_gush.lore: During his championship of the Sunken Isles, Leviathan gained mastery over the open sea.
tidehunter_gush.2_custom_description: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
tidehunter_gush.2_custom_lore: During his championship of the Sunken Isles, Leviathan gained mastery over the open sea.

tidehunter_kraken_shell.name: Kraken Shell
tidehunter_kraken_shell.description:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Does not stack with items that provide Damage Block.

Dispel Type: Strong Dispel
tidehunter_kraken_shell.lore: Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.
tidehunter_kraken_shell.note0: Only damage from player owned sources is counted towards debuff removal.
tidehunter_kraken_shell.note1: The counter will reset if no player owned damage is taken for %damage_reset_interval% seconds.
tidehunter_kraken_shell.note2: Kraken Shell removes most debuffs, even if they are generally not purgable.

tidehunter_anchor_smash.name: Anchor Smash
tidehunter_anchor_smash.description: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage.
tidehunter_anchor_smash.lore: Stolen from one of Admiral Kunkka's flagships, Leviathan's heavy anchor proves useful as a melee weapon.

tidehunter_ravage.name: Ravage
tidehunter_ravage.description: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
tidehunter_ravage.lore: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.

skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.description: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's Intellect. Upon impact, leaves a debuff that increases Skywrath Mage's spell lifesteal against the target.
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.lore: Within the Ghastly Eyrie's endless intrigue, only the clever and calm can hope to survive.
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.note0: The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.

skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.name: Concussive Shot
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.description: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range.  Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.lore: Those who serve the court of the Ghastly Eyrie are ever locked in covert war. One must always know where danger lurks nearest.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.note0: If no enemy heroes are in range or they are in fog, Concussive Shot targets the nearest enemy creep.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.note1: Damages creeps around the impact area.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.note2: Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.

skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.name: Ancient Seal
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.description: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.shard_description: Ancient Seal debuff now causes other debuffs applied to last 50%% longer. Grants vision over the target.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.lore: A holy incantation, whosoever finds themselves touched by Avilliva's sigil must suffer in penitent silence.

skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.name: Mystic Flare
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.description: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over %duration% seconds.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.lore: Only the most practiced of Skywrath sorcerers could hope to shape the skies into such a storm.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.note0: Spell immune enemies do not count toward the damage distribution.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.note1: Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.

pudge_meat_hook.name: Meat Hook
pudge_meat_hook.description: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge.
pudge_meat_hook.lore: The Butcher's hook is a symbolic nightmare, its curved blade a frightening reminder of his slaughterous intent.
pudge_meat_hook.note0: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
pudge_meat_hook.note1: Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
pudge_meat_hook.note2: Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.

pudge_rot.name: Rot
pudge_rot.description: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
pudge_rot.lore: A foul odor precedes a toxic, choking gas, emanating from the Butcher's putrid, ever-swelling mass.
pudge_rot.note1: If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
pudge_rot.bomb_description: The hero throws a gob of stench that applies Rot at the target location.
pudge_rot.bomb_lore: I'm like a shawarma - if you're not lucky, you'll suffer.

pudge_flesh_heap.name: Flesh Heap
pudge_flesh_heap.description:
Gives Pudge a guaranteed damage block against all types of attack. Passively grants bonus strength that increases each time Pudge kills an enemy Hero or it dies in his vicinity. Flesh Heap is retroactive, meaning it can gain charges before it is skilled, which then become active. 
 In Arena mode, the hero gains a Stack of Flesh Heap at the end of each round.
pudge_flesh_heap.lore: The Butcher gives new meaning to the words 'meat shield.'

pudge_dismember.name: Dismember
pudge_dismember.description: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Pudge gets healed for the same amount he damages. Lasts longer on creeps.
pudge_dismember.lore: 'When I'm through with these vermin, they'll be fit for a pie!'

bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.name: Shuriken Toss
bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.description: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's Movement Speed by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.
bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.lore: While the shuriken may be small, Gondar's precise aim can cause critical damage.

bounty_hunter_jinada.name: Jinada
bounty_hunter_jinada.description: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage. If the target was a Hero, then steals gold sacrifices that she did not even know.
bounty_hunter_jinada.lore: Gondar's vast experience ensures he never walks away from a transaction empty-handed.

bounty_hunter_wind_walk.name: Shadow Walk
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.description: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains the ability to move through other units until he attacks or uses an ability.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.lore: The court jesters present during King Goff's assassination can recount no other image than a dancing shadow.
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.note0: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.

bounty_hunter_track.name: Track
bounty_hunter_track.description: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. Bounty Hunter moves fast when near the tracked unit. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
bounty_hunter_track.lore: Using his elevated senses of sight and smell, Gondar's hits have quite a good chance of success.
bounty_hunter_track.note0: Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
bounty_hunter_track.note1: Track's effect is only visible to allies.
bounty_hunter_track.note2: You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.

nature's_prophet_sprout.name: Sprout
nature's_prophet_sprout.description: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, trapping it in place, and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
nature's_prophet_sprout.lore: Verdant overgrowth is a common ailment reported by Nature's Prophet's attackers.
nature's_prophet_sprout.note0: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
nature's_prophet_sprout.note1: Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
nature's_prophet_sprout.note2: A Tango that consumes a tree created by Sprout provides double the heal duration.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_description: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, trapping it in place, and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_lore: Verdant overgrowth is a common ailment reported by Nature's Prophet's attackers.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_note0: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_note1: Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_note2: A Tango that consumes a tree created by Sprout provides double the heal duration.

nature's_prophet_teleportation.name: Teleportation
nature's_prophet_teleportation.description: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
nature's_prophet_teleportation.lore: The Prophet keeps his sentinel over the forest, protecting it when in need.
nature's_prophet_teleportation.note0: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed.  Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
nature's_prophet_teleportation.note1: When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.

nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.name: Nature's Call
nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.description: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.lore: Verodicia bestowed the Prophet with the ability to summon the Treant Guard, a mythical sentient army of the wild.
nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.note0: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.

nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.name: Wrath of Nature
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.description: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies close to the cast point that are in vision. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage.
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.lore: Nature's Prophet calls Verodicia's fury to strike down those who might ravage the wilderness.
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.note0: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.note1: Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.

phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.name: Stifling Dagger
phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.description: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing %base_damage%+%attack_factor_tooltip%%% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.note0: If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.note1: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.note2: Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.
phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.lore: The first skill learned by the Sisters of the Veil often signals an incoming hit.

phantom_assassin_phantom_strike.name: Phantom Strike
phantom_assassin_phantom_strike.description: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.
phantom_assassin_phantom_strike.lore: Mortred's silken veil is the last thing her unfortunate target sees.

phantom_assassin_blur.name: Blur
phantom_assassin_blur.description: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
phantom_assassin_blur.lore: Meditation allows the Veil Sisters to outpace their foes in battle.

phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace.name: Coup de Grace
phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace.description: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.
phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace.lore: A divine strike, Mortred honors her opponent by choosing them for death.

doom_devour.name: Devour
doom_devour.description: Devours an enemy or neutral creep, gaining additional armor for the duration while it is being digested.
doom_devour.lore: Lucifer's appetite and greed are never sated.
doom_devour.note0: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.

doom_scorched_earth.name: Scorched Earth
doom_scorched_earth.description: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting him increased movement speed.
doom_scorched_earth.lore: The Fallen One spreads destruction in his wake, sparing none from the flame which sustains him.
doom_scorched_earth.note0: Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.

doom_infernal_blade.name: Infernal Blade
doom_infernal_blade.description:
Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for %ministun_duration% seconds and applies a %burn_duration% second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second. 
 Damage from Maximum Health only works at 50% against Creeps.
doom_infernal_blade.lore: Lucifer shares the fire branding bestowed upon him at the time of his exile.

doom_doom.name: Doom
doom_doom.description: Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy Hero and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
doom_doom.lore: When a name is tolled from the bell of Vashundol, doom is sure to follow.

death_prophet_carrion_swarm.description: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.lore: Krobelus' many trips to the grave gather a flock of the damned.
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.note0: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.

death_prophet_silence.name: Silence
death_prophet_silence.description: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
death_prophet_silence.lore: Peering into the veil of her opponent's demise, Krobelus sees a silent future.

death_prophet_exorcism.name: Exorcism
death_prophet_exorcism.description:
Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Lasts %duration% seconds.
Passively grants Movement Speed.
death_prophet_exorcism.lore: Over time, the banshee remnants of her previous lives return to haunt the present.
death_prophet_exorcism.note0: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
death_prophet_exorcism.note1: Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.

undying_decay.name: Decay
undying_decay.description: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals %creep_damage_multiplier%x damage to creeps.
undying_decay.lore: The strength of the living is simply borrowed from the strength of the dead.
undying_decay.note0: The strength stolen stacks, but can't cause a hero to have strength below 1.
undying_decay.note1: The strength steal takes effect before the damage is dealt.

undying_soul_rip.name: Soul Rip
undying_soul_rip.description: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
undying_soul_rip.lore: Even allies feel despair in Undying's presence.
undying_soul_rip.note0: Can heal Tombstone, but can't heal or damage other buildings.
undying_soul_rip.note1: Does not rip from invisible units, invulnerable units, units in the fog of war, or spell immune enemies.

undying_tombstone.name: Tombstone
undying_tombstone.description: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
undying_tombstone.lore: Dirge calls on his fallen brothers to fight for the Dead God.
undying_tombstone.note0: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
undying_tombstone.note1: Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
undying_tombstone.note2: If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.
undying_tombstone.zombie_deathstrike_description: Slows enemy units on attack.  If the attacked unit's health goes below the threshold, the zombie receives enhanced movement and attack speed.
undying_tombstone.body_description: Periodically summons a zombie near each enemy in the area of effect. First of all, the heroes.
undying_tombstone.body_lore: In the name of the Scourge!

invoker_exort.note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.

invoker_invoke.name: Invoke
invoker_invoke.description: Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_orb% seconds for each orb level.
invoker_invoke.lore: So begins a new age of knowledge.
invoker_invoke.note0: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
invoker_invoke.note1: Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.

invoker_cold_snap.name: Cold Snap
invoker_cold_snap.description: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
invoker_cold_snap.note0: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.

invoker_ghost_walk.name: Ghost Walk
invoker_ghost_walk.description: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body transparent. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, and speeds up Invoker as well based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Can be dispelled. The ability is not interrupted by the hero's attacks or spells.
invoker_ghost_walk.note0: The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.

invoker_tornado.name: Tornado
invoker_tornado.description: Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
invoker_tornado.note0: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

invoker_emp.ty1_custom_description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.
invoker_emp.ty2_custom_description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.
invoker_emp.name: E.M.P.
invoker_emp.description: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 50% of the mana drained.
invoker_emp.note0: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).

invoker_alacrity.name: Alacrity
invoker_alacrity.description: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> and their damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.

invoker_chaos_meteor.name: Chaos Meteor
invoker_chaos_meteor.description: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, and rolling further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
invoker_chaos_meteor.note0: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every %damage_interval% seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over %burn_duration% seconds.
invoker_chaos_meteor.note1: The meteor moves at a speed of %travel_speed%.

invoker_sun_strike.name: Sun Strike
invoker_sun_strike.description: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
invoker_sun_strike.note0: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
invoker_sun_strike.note1: Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.

invoker_forge_spirit.name: Forge Spirit
invoker_forge_spirit.description: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. Spawns two spirits when Quas and Exort are at least level 4.
invoker_forge_spirit.note0: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

invoker_ice_wall.name: Ice Wall
invoker_ice_wall.description: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and deals damage each second based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
invoker_ice_wall.note0: The slow will still affect Spell Immune enemies if their spell immunity was created after being affected by Ice Wall.

invoker_deafening_blast.name: Deafening Blast
invoker_deafening_blast.description: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.

terrorblade_reflection.name: Reflection
terrorblade_reflection.description: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes are slowed and attacked by their reflection.
terrorblade_reflection.lore: In the fractal prison of Foulfell, Terrorblade learned the truth of this old tale: you are your own worst enemy.  Now it is a lesson he teaches others.
terrorblade_reflection.note0: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
terrorblade_reflection.note1: Reflections can only attack their source.

terrorblade_conjure_image.name: Conjure Image
terrorblade_conjure_image.description: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.
terrorblade_conjure_image.lore: There's only one thing more dangerous than facing Terrorblade. Facing MORE Terrorblades!
terrorblade_conjure_image.note0: Illusions created by Conjure Image are visually different for enemies.

terrorblade_metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
terrorblade_metamorphosis.description: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within %metamorph_aura_tooltip% range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.
terrorblade_metamorphosis.lore: Temper, temper. The rage rises up and takes control. Meet Terrorblade's own worst self.
terrorblade_metamorphosis.note0: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Terrorblade was in when the item was used.

terrorblade_sunder.name: Sunder
terrorblade_sunder.description: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
terrorblade_sunder.lore: You didn't need that life, did you?  The demon marauder steals that which you hold most dear.

vengeful_spirit_magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
vengeful_spirit_magic_missile.description:
Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage. 
 In Arena mode, the hero gains Mana from Talent at the end of each round.
vengeful_spirit_magic_missile.lore: A simple Skywrath technique, the magic missile is Shendel's primary tool for vengeance.

vengeful_spirit_wave_of_terror.name: Wave of Terror
vengeful_spirit_wave_of_terror.description: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
vengeful_spirit_wave_of_terror.lore: Shendel's haunting voice hints at her approaching vindication.

vengeful_spirit_command_aura.name: Vengeance Aura
vengeful_spirit_command_aura.description: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes.
vengeful_spirit_command_aura.lore: Although they may not share her undying passion for revenge, allies do draw on her fanaticism in combat.

vengeful_spirit_nether_swap.name: Nether Swap
vengeful_spirit_nether_swap.description: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
vengeful_spirit_nether_swap.lore: Martyrdom is a small price to pay for vengeance.
vengeful_spirit_nether_swap.note1: Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
vengeful_spirit_nether_swap.note2: Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.

muerta_dead_shot.name: DEAD SHOT
muerta_dead_shot.description:
Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
muerta_dead_shot.lore: A steady gunhand and an eternity of practice produce trickshots that defy the mortal mind.

muerta_the_calling.name: THE CALLING
muerta_the_calling.description: Summons a group of %num_revenants% revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed and have reduced attack speed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.
muerta_the_calling.lore: Muerta's family are forever beyond the spirit veil, but her deal with Death allows her to briefly call on them in times of want or need.

muerta_gunslinger.name: GUNSLINGER
muerta_gunslinger.description: Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target, prioritizing Heroes.
muerta_gunslinger.lore: Muerta offers all of her victims Mercy. Some are fortunate enough to also earn Grace.

muerta_pierce_the_veil.name: PIERCE THE VEIL
muerta_pierce_the_veil.description:
Muerta transforms, becoming immune to physical damage. All of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage. Muerta gains bonus attack damage and phased movement.

Muerta can attack ethereal units, but deals no damage to Magic Immune targets.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
muerta_pierce_the_veil.lore: Muerta sheds her corporeal form, crossing the spirit veil and striking her enemies with the fury of the damned.

legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.name: Overwhelming Odds
legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.description: Turns the enemies' numbers against them, dealing damage per unit or per hero and granting you bonus attack speed . Deals bonus damage to illusions and summoned units as a percent of their current health. Can be cast during Duel.
legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.lore: The archers of Stonehall are ready at Tresdin's command.

legion_commander_press_the_attack.name: Press The Attack
legion_commander_press_the_attack.description: Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
legion_commander_press_the_attack.lore: The rallying horn of the Bronze Legion is able to inspire any heart.

legion_commander_moment_of_courage.name: Moment of Courage
legion_commander_moment_of_courage.description: When attacked, Legion Commander has a chance to immediately counterattack with bonus lifesteal.
legion_commander_moment_of_courage.lore: Tresdin knows that an enemy's most vulnerable moment often follows their fiercest stroke.

legion_commander_duel.name: Duel
legion_commander_duel.description:
Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration.  Neither hero can use items or abilities.  If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage. 
 In Arena mode, the hero takes 25% Duel Damage at the end of each round.
legion_commander_duel.note0: Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.
legion_commander_duel.note1: Winning a Duel automatically casts Press the Attack on yourself.
legion_commander_duel.lore: To face a soldier of Stonehall in single combat is a challenge few can resist.

lion_impale.name: Earth Spike
lion_impale.description: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
lion_impale.lore: The Demon Witch exercises his demonic covenant, opening a fissure from hell.
lion_impale.note0: The spikes move at %speed% units per second.

lion_voodoo.name: Hex
lion_voodoo.description: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
lion_voodoo.lore: Lion is compelled to share his transfiguration, twisting the essence of those who oppose him.
lion_voodoo.note1: The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

lion_mana_drain.name: Mana Drain
lion_mana_drain.description: CHANNELED - Absorbs the magical energies of a target enemy unit by taking mana from it every second.
lion_mana_drain.lore: Lesser magi are nothing more than a source of magical restoration for the Demon Witch.
lion_mana_drain.note0: Instantly destroys illusions and prevents heroes from going invisible.

lion_finger_of_death.name: Finger of Death
lion_finger_of_death.description:
Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out. Deals massive damage and grows stronger with each life it consumes. 
 In Arena mode, the hero takes Finger of Death Damage at the end of each round.
lion_finger_of_death.lore: Lion's disfigured hand is also the source of his greatest power, capable of flooding victims with malefic force.
lion_finger_of_death.note0: Finger of Death has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
lion_finger_of_death.note1: Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within %grace_period% seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.

kunkka_torrent.name: Torrent
kunkka_torrent.description: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
kunkka_torrent.lore: An ancestral rush of water explodes from the center of the world, called upon by the Admiral.
kunkka_torrent.note0: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
kunkka_torrent.note1: Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.
kunkka_torrent.storm_custom_description: Releases a visible Torrent in a random area around Kunkka once every %torrent_interval% for %torrent_duration% seconds. Spawns within %torrent_max_distance% range of him.
kunkka_torrent.storm_custom_lore: A hundred leagues of dry land couldn't keep these seas at bay.

kunkka_tidebringer.name: Tidebringer
kunkka_tidebringer.description: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
kunkka_tidebringer.lore: A lost Claddish soul inhabits Kunkka's trusty Tidebringer, empowering it to destroy demons of the Cataract.

kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.name: X Marks the Spot
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.description: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.lore: The Admiral's set of arcane abilities includes some that can be used for battle as well as entertainment.
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.note0: If the target becomes Spell Immune after the cast, the target will not return to the X after the duration.

kunkka_ghostship.name: Ghostship
kunkka_ghostship.description: Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage. Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a swig of The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to incoming damage.
kunkka_ghostship.lore: The final ship of the Claddish Navy is nothing but a phantom, but it is all too real to the enemies of the Admiral.
kunkka_ghostship.note0: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.
kunkka_ghostship.note1: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
kunkka_ghostship.note2: The boat has a movement speed of %ghostship_speed%.

slardar_sprint.name: Guardian Sprint
slardar_sprint.description: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration and armor while in a puddle or river.
slardar_sprint.lore: As Slardar has made the transition from the Deeps, it has been necessary to use his powerful tail for sprinting instead of swimming.
slardar_sprint.note0: Activating this skill doesn't interrupt channeling abilities.

slardar_slithereen_crush.name: Slithereen Crush
slardar_slithereen_crush.description: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
slardar_slithereen_crush.lore: A swift crush of might and water breaks even the toughest of defenses.

slardar_bash.name: Bash of the Deep
slardar_bash.description: After %attack_count% attacks, your next attack will bash the target. Deals double damage against creeps.
slardar_bash.lore: Thieves of the wealth of the Deep Ones meet the brutality of the Slithereen Guard in melee combat.
slardar_bash.note0: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

slardar_amplify_damage.name: Corrosive Haze
slardar_amplify_damage.description: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it for 8 seconds.
slardar_amplify_damage.lore: Even the strongest armor counts for little when left to the brine of the sea.

morphling_waveform.name: Waveform
morphling_waveform.description: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path.  Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
morphling_waveform.lore: A torrential flood takes enemies by force.
morphling_waveform.reverse_custom_description: This ability can be cast within %delay% seconds of Waveform to return to its original position.

morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.name: Adaptive Strike (Agility)
morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.description: Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used. Passively grants bonus Agility. \n\n Also puts Adaptive Strike (Strength) on a %shared_cooldown% second cooldown.
morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.lore: The Morphling calls upon his elements to crush his opponents with waves.

morphling_adaptive_strike_str.name: Adaptive Strike (Strength)
morphling_adaptive_strike_str.description: Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning and knocking back the target based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum stun/knockback is dealt. Passively grants bonus Strength. \n\n Also puts Adaptive Strike (Agility) on a %shared_cooldown% second cooldown.
morphling_adaptive_strike_str.lore: The Morphling calls upon his elements to crush his opponents with waves.

morphling_morph_agi.name: Attribute Shift (Agility Gain)
morphling_morph_agi.description: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility. The process is reversible.  Additional points in Attribute Shift increase the rate of stat change.  Passively grants bonus Agility.
morphling_morph_agi.lore: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
morphling_morph_agi.note0: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
morphling_morph_agi.note1: Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.

morphling_morph_str.name: Attribute Shift (Strength Gain)
morphling_morph_str.description: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength. The process is reversible.  Additional points in Attribute Shift increase the rate of stat change.  Passively grants bonus Strength.
morphling_morph_str.lore: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
morphling_morph_str.note0: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
morphling_morph_str.note1: Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.

morphling_replicate.name: Morph
morphling_replicate.description: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
morphling_replicate.lore: Staring into Morphling produces a reflection that mimics the beholder.
morphling_replicate.note0: You can't target yourself with Morph.

slark_dark_pact.name: Dark Pact
slark_dark_pact.description: After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes %self_damage_pct%%% of the damage.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
slark_dark_pact.lore: Slithereen are capable of quickly regrowing appendages, in case of critical injury, to save their own lives.
slark_dark_pact.note0: %delay% seconds after cast, a series of %total_pulses% pulses separated by %pulse_interval% seconds deal the damage.
slark_dark_pact.note1: Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
slark_dark_pact.note2: You can't kill yourself with this skill.
slark_dark_pact.note3: The pulses stop if Slark dies.

slark_pounce.name: Pounce
slark_pounce.description: Slark leaps forward, leashing the first hero he connects.  That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
slark_pounce.lore: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.
slark_pounce.note0: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
slark_pounce.note1: Spell Immune units cannot be leashed.
slark_pounce.note2: Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.
slark_pounce.2_description: Slark leaps forward, leashing the first hero he connects.  That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.

slark_pounce.2_note2: Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.

slark_essence_shift.name: Essence Shift
slark_essence_shift.description:
Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, gaining additional agility for himself. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility. 
 In Arena mode, the hero gains a Stack of Agility at the end of each round.
slark_essence_shift.lore: With each strike at his adversaries, Slark's knowledge of their weaknesses improves.
slark_essence_shift.note0: To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within 300 range of Slark while having the Essence Shift debuff.

slark_shadow_dance.name: Shadow Dance
slark_shadow_dance.description: When used, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark.  Passively, when not visible to the enemy team, Slark gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.
slark_shadow_dance.lore: The hidden Thirteenth is a slippery foe.
slark_shadow_dance.note0: If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.
slark_shadow_dance.note1: The passive movement and health regeneration bonuses have a %activation_delay% second activation and deactivation delay.

oracle_fortunes_end.name: Fortune's End
oracle_fortunes_end.description: CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration is equal to the time spent channeling.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
oracle_fortunes_end.lore: The astral orb crackles with power while raw energy lances out, temporarily disrupting an enemy's connection to their own body.
oracle_fortunes_end.note0: Can be cast on invulnerable units.

oracle_fates_edict.name: Fate's Edict
oracle_fates_edict.description: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them if they are an enemy and granting them %magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%%% magic damage resistance if they are an ally.
oracle_fates_edict.lore: An unbreakable prophecy resounds: a chosen ally shall briefly suffer no magics. Other kinds of suffering however...

oracle_purifying_flames.name: Purifying Flames
oracle_purifying_flames.description: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.
oracle_purifying_flames.lore: Like a hall of mirrors might amplify the light of a single candle, the shattered walls of the universe can transform the light of prophecy into a burning torch.
oracle_purifying_flames.note0: The healing from Purifying Flames can be stacked with itself.
oracle_purifying_flames.note1: The damage from Purifying Flames cannot be lethal to allies.

oracle_false_promise.name: False Promise
oracle_false_promise.description: Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
oracle_false_promise.lore: Foes and false prophets oft make lies of men's fates.
oracle_false_promise.note0: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
oracle_false_promise.note1: The delayed damage and healing takes effect as soon as the target becomes vulnerable.

disruptor_thunder_strike.name: Thunder Strike
disruptor_thunder_strike.description: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.
disruptor_thunder_strike.lore: Disruptor's charged coils occasionally overload, and a singed armor plate or tuft of fur is the enemy's result.

disruptor_glimpse.name: Glimpse
disruptor_glimpse.description: Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4 seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage based on distance glimpsed, with max damage dealt at %max_distance% distance.
disruptor_glimpse.lore: Playing with electricity can have unexpected results.
disruptor_glimpse.note0: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.

disruptor_kinetic_field.name: Kinetic Field
disruptor_kinetic_field.description: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
disruptor_kinetic_field.lore: The stryder is immune to the gale-force winds that will consume its adversaries.
disruptor_kinetic_field.note0: Spell Immune units can travel through the field.

disruptor_static_storm.name: Static Storm
disruptor_static_storm.description: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
disruptor_static_storm.lore: A summer squall in Druud is a hardship that only an Oglodi can survive.

juggernaut_blade_fury.name: Blade Fury
juggernaut_blade_fury.description: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune, increasing his magic resistance by 80%%, and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
juggernaut_blade_fury.lore: Yurnero's renowned katana techniques are feared by warriors and sorcerors alike.
juggernaut_blade_fury.note0: You can use items during Blade Fury.
juggernaut_blade_fury.note1: Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.

juggernaut_healing_ward.name: Healing Ward
juggernaut_healing_ward.description: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned. Lasts %duration% seconds.
juggernaut_healing_ward.lore: Of the rituals learned at the Isle of Masks, tending wounds with a bit of voodoo magic has proven to be quite useful.
juggernaut_healing_ward.note0: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
juggernaut_healing_ward.note1: Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.

juggernaut_blade_dance.name: Blade Dance
juggernaut_blade_dance.description: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage on each attack.
juggernaut_blade_dance.lore: The last remnant of his heritage's commitment to bladework, Yurnero ensures that the style is remembered.

juggernaut_omni_slash.name: Omnislash
juggernaut_omni_slash.description: Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
juggernaut_omni_slash.lore: The fruits of discipline; with practice comes strength.
juggernaut_omni_slash.note0: You can use items during Omnislash.

spectre_spectral_dagger.name: Spectral Dagger
spectre_spectral_dagger.description: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre phases through otherwise impassable terrain. Spectral Dagger applies Desolate.
spectre_spectral_dagger.lore: Mercurial's dagger eclipses the physical plane in shadow, a state in which mortals cower, but spectres thrive.
spectre_spectral_dagger.note0: There is a %dagger_grace_period% second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.

spectre_desolate.name: Desolate
spectre_desolate.description: Deals bonus damage whenever Spectre attacks an enemy that does not have any allied units within a %radius% radius around them.
spectre_desolate.lore: Often times, warriors find themselves alone with a vision of Mercurial - the fated question is if it is the true Spectre.
spectre_desolate.note0: Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.

spectre_dispersion.name: Dispersion
spectre_dispersion.description:
Damage done to Spectre is reflected on her enemies, leaving her unharmed. The effect lessens with distance. 
 In Arena mode, the hero deals 50% Dispersion Damage.
spectre_dispersion.lore: A daunting task lies before enemies of Mercurial - killing a shadow with blade and magic.
spectre_dispersion.note0: The reflected damage is not dealt to Spectre.
spectre_dispersion.note2: Damage is reflected before reductions, and is returned as the same damage type.

spectre_reality.name: Reality
spectre_reality.description: Spectre exchanges places with a chosen Haunt and casts the current level of Spectral Dagger on the haunt's target.
spectre_reality.lore: The scattered shadows unite into the one true Spectre.

spectre_haunt.name: Haunt
spectre_haunt.description: Creates a spectral nemesis to attack enemy hero near closest to the cast point. At any moment during the duration, Spectre can use Reality to exchange places of a given haunt.\n\nHaunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself. They ignore terrain.
spectre_haunt.lore: At the height of combat, Mercurial's physical manifestation shatters, and the shadowy pieces haunt those who still cling to life.

bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.name: Viscous Nasal Goo
bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.description: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.lore: Having caught a cold while stuck in the snow, Bristleback turns it to his advantage.

bristleback_quill_spray.name: Quill Spray
bristleback_quill_spray.description:
Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last %quill_stack_duration% seconds. 
 In Arena mode, the hero deals 50% Quill Spray DMG.
bristleback_quill_spray.lore: An enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing.  So can his quills.
bristleback_quill_spray.note0: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

bristleback_bristleback.name: Bristleback
bristleback_bristleback.description: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear.  If Bristleback takes %quill_release_threshold% damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
bristleback_bristleback.lore: Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.
bristleback_bristleback.note0: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
bristleback_bristleback.note1: Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.

bristleback_warpath.name: Warpath
bristleback_warpath.description: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
bristleback_warpath.lore: 'Temper, temper,' his mum always chided.  But in a fight, a temper can come in handy.
bristleback_warpath.note0: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.

spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.name: Charge of Darkness
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.lore: Barathrum erupts from the darkness with unwieldy force.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.description: Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects.  All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.  If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.note0: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.note1: The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.note2: Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.

spirit_breaker_bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
spirit_breaker_bulldoze.description: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.
spirit_breaker_bulldoze.lore: Barathrum warps the fabric of reality around him, lessening its influence on his physical form.

spirit_breaker_greater_bash.name: Greater Bash
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.lore: The signature strike of Barathrum's ghostly ball and chain.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.description: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage. Deals 1.5x damage to creeps.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.note0: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

spirit_breaker_nether_strike.name: Nether Strike
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.lore: Barathrum temporarily returns to the realm from where he came, bringing with him the retribution of both worlds.
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.description: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.note0: Spirit Breaker appears behind the target to deliver the bash.

ancient_apparition_cold_feet.name: Cold Feet
ancient_apparition_cold_feet.description: Places a frozen hex on an enemy unit that deals damage over time, but can be dispelled by moving away from the initial cast point.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range, it will be stunned and frozen in place after 4 seconds.
ancient_apparition_cold_feet.lore: Kaldr's presence draws those around him into a frozen void, threatening to lock them in an icy prison for eternity.

ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.name: Ice Vortex
ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.description: Creates a vortex of icy energy that deals damage, slows and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.lore: Frozen, caustic winds are at the whim of Kaldr, chilling the field of battle.
ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.note0: Provides vision in a small area where it is placed.

ancient_apparition_chilling_touch.name: Chilling Touch
ancient_apparition_chilling_touch.description: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range, heavy magic damage, and movement slow.
ancient_apparition_chilling_touch.lore: The Ancient Apparition's eternal knowledge brings a frigid enchantment to his attacks.

ancient_apparition_ice_blast.name: Ice Blast
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.description: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.lore: Ice storms from ages past flow through Kaldr's frosty limbs, crashing into the world and turning its inhabitants into monuments to his eternal power.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.note0: Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.note1: The area of effect is %radius_min% + %radius_grow%*TimeTraveled, capped at %radius_max%.  The freeze area along the path is %path_radius%.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.note2: Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.note3: The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.note4: The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.release_custom_description: Releases the ice blast to explode at the tracer's current location.

lich_frost_nova.name: Frost Blast
lich_frost_nova.description: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.
lich_frost_nova.lore: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.
lich_frost_nova.ring_custom_description: Casts Frost Blast after a short delay in a circle around the hero.
lich_frost_nova.ring_custom_lore: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.
lich_frost_nova.line_custom_description: Casts Frost Blast after a short delay along the line in front of the hero.
lich_frost_nova.line_custom_lore: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.

lich_frost_shield.name: Frost Shield
lich_frost_shield.description: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every %interval% seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
lich_frost_shield.lore: First conceived of to protect him in his mortal years, the frost magic that Ethreain weaves around himself has only grown colder with time.
lich_frost_shield.note0: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.

lich_sinister_gaze.name: Sinister Gaze
lich_sinister_gaze.description: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana. If cast on a creep lasts %creep_duration_multiplier%x longer and deals %creep_damage% damage per second.

lich_chain_frost.name: Chain Frost
lich_chain_frost.description: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces.
lich_chain_frost.lore: Almost universally considered the ultimate in frost magic, Ethreain's orb of frozen death strikes fear into those who dare stand against him.
lich_chain_frost.note1: Chain Frost has a movement speed of %projectile_speed%.
lich_chain_frost.note2: Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.
