dazzle_poison_touch.name: Poison Touch
dazzle_poison_touch.description: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
dazzle_poison_touch.lore: One of the few Dezun rites used for offensive purposes, the paralytic enchantment often proves useful.
dazzle_poison_touch.note0: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
dazzle_poison_touch.note1: Units afflicted by Poison Touch can be denied when their HP drops below 25%.

dazzle_shallow_grave.name: Shallow Grave
dazzle_shallow_grave.description: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP. In Arena mode, cooldown is increased by 50%.
dazzle_shallow_grave.lore: Only a seasoned acolyte of the Shadow can properly perform the rite of preventing death.
dazzle_shallow_grave.note0: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.

dazzle_shadow_wave.name: Shadow Wave
dazzle_shadow_wave.description: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
dazzle_shadow_wave.lore: While it is a simplistic and routine rite among Shadow Priests, the Shadow Wave is also the most critical for success.
dazzle_shadow_wave.note1: If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.

dazzle_nothl_projection.description: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.

wraith_king_hellfire_blast.name: Wraithfire Blast
wraith_king_hellfire_blast.description: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target. Summoned skeletons around the target will receive bonus movement and attack speed for the duration of the debuff.
wraith_king_hellfire_blast.lore: Ostarion calls on his damned lineage, laying waste to his opponents.
wraith_king_hellfire_blast.note0: If Wraith King has summoned skeletons, casting Wraithfire Blast on a target will order all of the skeletons to attack that target.

wraith_king_vampiric_aura.name: Vampiric Spirit
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.description:
Restore health based on the damage Wraith King deals when attacking enemy units. Can be cast to summon skeletons with Vampiric Spirit. Skeletons respawn once when killed.

Lifesteal from creeps is reduced by %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%. 

 Skeletons can be controlled.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.lore: Wraith King's blade drains his enemy's essence to feed his aura.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note0: Summoned skeletons will automatically attack any unit targeted by Wraithfire Blast.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note1: Stacks additively with other sources of Lifesteal.

wraith_king_mortal_strike.name: Mortal Strike
wraith_king_mortal_strike.description: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.
wraith_king_mortal_strike.lore: One blow to crush a foe.

wraith_king_reincarnation.name: Reincarnation
wraith_king_reincarnation.description: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a %slow_radius% radius will be slowed.
wraith_king_reincarnation.lore: Conspirators against the Wraith King wonder why he never stays dead.
wraith_king_reincarnation.note0: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
wraith_king_reincarnation.note1: Revives with full HP and Mana.

weaver_the_swarm.name: The Swarm
weaver_the_swarm.description: Weaver launches a swarm of %count% young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
weaver_the_swarm.lore: Skitskurr opens a gap in the space time fabric, allowing young Weavers to slip through and aid him in combat.
weaver_the_swarm.note0: When a beetle latches on a target, it will remain there until it is killed or the duration expires.
weaver_the_swarm.note1: Beetles are Spell Immune, but can be killed in %destroy_attacks% attacks from a unit. Heroes deal double damage to beetles.

weaver_shukuchi.name: Shukuchi
weaver_shukuchi.description: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed - doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
weaver_shukuchi.lore: As the Weavers worked in the fabric of creation, small wormholes allowed them to slip through time to better work their craft.
weaver_shukuchi.note0: Can only damage the same unit once per cast.

weaver_geminate_attack.name: Geminate Attack
weaver_geminate_attack.description: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.
weaver_geminate_attack.lore: Skitskurr's relationship with time is somewhat variable, causing his actions to be witnessed - and felt - more than once.
weaver_geminate_attack.note0: Additional attacks leave Weaver %delay% seconds after the previous one, and have no range limit.

weaver_time_lapse.name: Time Lapse
weaver_time_lapse.description: Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
weaver_time_lapse.lore: If Skitskurr does not deem the current reality of the world to fit his desires, he simply crawls back in time to right what was wronged.
weaver_time_lapse.note0: Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.

abaddon_death_coil.name: Mist Coil
abaddon_death_coil.description: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
abaddon_death_coil.lore: A mysterious vapor from the Font of Avernus now infuses the breath of Abaddon, who releases it at will.
abaddon_death_coil.note0: Abaddon can not kill himself with this skill.

abaddon_aphotic_shield.name: Aphotic Shield
abaddon_aphotic_shield.description: Summons dark energies around an ally unit, creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it. Removes certain types of negative buffs and stuns on cast.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abaddon_aphotic_shield.lore: The powers of the black mist rise to absorb attacks like the black mist absorbs light.
abaddon_aphotic_shield.note0: The max damage is always dealt whether the barrier is destroyed by expiring or absorbing damage.
abaddon_aphotic_shield.note1: The explosion does not damage units hidden by the fog of war.

abaddon_frostmourne.name: Curse of Avernus
abaddon_frostmourne.description: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by %tower_dps_pct%%%.
abaddon_frostmourne.lore: While the baptized draw strength from the Font, the gifts of Avernus are debilitating to the uninitiated.

abaddon_borrowed_time.name: Borrowed Time
abaddon_borrowed_time.description: When activated, all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. Most negative buffs will also be removed. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below %hp_threshold%.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abaddon_borrowed_time.lore: The most unnatural of all the gifts of the Font of Avernus, this power defies mortal understanding.  What should hurt, instead heals; and what should kill gives strength anew.
abaddon_borrowed_time.note0: Borrowed Time can be manually activated while Abaddon is disabled, but not while silenced. The passive activation can still occur while silenced.
abaddon_borrowed_time.note1: Aphotic Shield does not block any damage to Abaddon when Borrowed Time is active, allowing him to heal.

medusa_split_shot.name: Split Shot
medusa_split_shot.description: Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.\n\nThe extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
medusa_split_shot.lore: All who encounter the cursed Gorgon will feel her rage.
medusa_split_shot.note0: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
medusa_split_shot.note1: If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.

medusa_mystic_snake.name: Mystic Snake
medusa_mystic_snake.description: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns %snake_mana_steal%%% mana based on the targets total mana. Restores %creep_mana_steal% mana per creep.
medusa_mystic_snake.lore: The Gorgon's curse is her greatest strength.

medusa_stone_gaze.name: Stone Gaze
medusa_stone_gaze.description: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If %face_duration% seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
medusa_stone_gaze.lore: The beauty of Medusa is legendary.
medusa_stone_gaze.note0: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.

medusa_mana_shield.name: Mana Shield
medusa_mana_shield.description: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb less damage per point of mana. Provides bonus mana capacity.
medusa_mana_shield.lore: While Medusa was not gifted with eternal life upon birth, her curse bestowed her with impressive defensive powers.
medusa_mana_shield.note0: Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.

naga_siren_mirror_image.name: Mirror Image
naga_siren_mirror_image.description: Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
naga_siren_mirror_image.lore: Slithice, while being strong in her own right, is notoriously hard to track down.
naga_siren_mirror_image.note0: Naga Siren is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
naga_siren_mirror_image.note1: Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
naga_siren_mirror_image.note2: Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.

naga_siren_ensnare.name: Ensnare
naga_siren_ensnare.description: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking.
naga_siren_ensnare.lore: The only way to escape the onslaught of a Slithereen is to never oppose one in the first place.

naga_siren_rip_tide.name: Rip Tide
naga_siren_rip_tide.description: Every %hits% attacks from naga and her illusions, the Naga Siren and her images will hit all nearby units with a damaging wave of water that lowers armor for %duration% seconds.
naga_siren_rip_tide.lore: A torrent from the Deep Ones crushes the defenses of the Siren's enemies.

naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.name: Song of the Siren
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.description: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.lore: Slithice's powerful voice enchants leagues of opponents, while calling her Slithereen kin in a time of need.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.note0: Units affected by Song of the Siren are invulnerable and cannot take damage from any source.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.note2: The area of the song follows Naga, so if she moves far enough away from affected units, they will wake up.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.cancel_custom_description: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.

tiny_avalanche.name: Avalanche
tiny_avalanche.description: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
tiny_avalanche.lore: Inanimate rock becomes animate when called by the Stone Giant.

tiny_toss.name: Toss
tiny_toss.description: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
tiny_toss.lore: Tiny's gargantuan stature allows him to catapult even the sturdiest of warriors.
tiny_toss.note0: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
tiny_toss.note1: Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
tiny_toss.tree_custom_description: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.
tiny_toss.tree_custom_lore: Even enemies can share in Tiny's arbor ardor.

tiny_tree_grab.name: Tree Grab
tiny_tree_grab.lore: Sticks and stones break all the bones, with structures sure to follow.
tiny_tree_grab.description: Grabs a tree to whack enemies on the head for a limited number of attacks. Grants bonus attack range. Attacks deal more damage and fully splash on units along the way. The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
tiny_tree_grab.note0: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.

tiny_grow.name: Grow
tiny_grow.description: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
tiny_grow.lore: Watching a hill become a mountain is awe-inspiring - especially if the mountain begins laying waste to adversaries.

night_stalker_void.name: Void
night_stalker_void.description: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and the slowing effect lasts longer.
night_stalker_void.lore: Balanar creates a vortex of infinite night, tearing opponents violently into the eternal darkness that once was.
night_stalker_void.note0: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.

night_stalker_crippling_fear.name: Crippling Fear
night_stalker_crippling_fear.description: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.
night_stalker_crippling_fear.lore: A vision of the twisted maw of Balanar etches itself into the minds of the poor souls unlucky enough to cross his path.

night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.name: Hunter in the Night
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.description: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.lore: The hunting prowess of Balanar improves as the night beckons.

night_stalker_darkness.name: Dark Ascension
night_stalker_darkness.description: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.
night_stalker_darkness.lore: It is a humbling sight to see when the mightiest of warriors become afraid of the dark.

necrophos_death_pulse.name: Death Pulse
necrophos_death_pulse.description: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
necrophos_death_pulse.lore: Poor souls who succumb to Rotund'jere's plagues are recycled for future use.

necrophos_ghost_shroud.name: Ghost Shroud
necrophos_ghost_shroud.description: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.
necrophos_ghost_shroud.lore: Rotund'jere uses the souls of his victims as bridge from life to afterlife.

necrophos_heartstopper_aura.name: Heartstopper Aura
necrophos_heartstopper_aura.description: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
necrophos_heartstopper_aura.lore: Those who come within a short distance of Necrophos can feel pestilence and plague in the air.
necrophos_heartstopper_aura.note0: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.

necrophos_reapers_scythe.name: Reaper's Scythe
necrophos_reapers_scythe.description: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
necrophos_reapers_scythe.lore: The amount of death and suffering in the air increases the power of Necrophos's plague magic.
necrophos_reapers_scythe.note0: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.

nyx_assassin_impale.name: Impale
nyx_assassin_impale.description: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
nyx_assassin_impale.lore: All zealot scarabs possess intimate knowledge of underground pathways, using them to their advantage.
nyx_assassin_impale.note0: The spikes move at %speed% units per second, over %length% range.
nyx_assassin_impale.note1: Impale cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere.

nyx_assassin_jolt.name: Mind Flare
nyx_assassin_jolt.description:
Deals damages to the enemy equal to a percentage of its Max Mana. Additionally deals damage equal to a percentage of damage the target received from Nyx Assassin in the past %damage_echo_duration% s. 
 Deals 50% damage to bosses.

nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.name: Spiked Carapace
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.description: When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.\n\nWhile Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.lore: While their carapace is relatively thin, it's guarded by a retractable field of razor-sharp spikes.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.note0: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.note1: Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled units.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.note2: The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx.

nyx_assassin_vendetta.name: Vendetta
nyx_assassin_vendetta.description: Grants the hero unobstructed vision and increases his movement speed. Having made an attack, the hero will inflict huge additional damage. This attack has a range increased by %attack_range_bonus% and animation accelerated by %attack_animation_bonus%%%.
nyx_assassin_vendetta.lore: The scarab kills for the glory of his queen.

techies_sticky_bomb.name: Sticky Bomb
techies_sticky_bomb.description: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for %secondary_slow_duration% seconds.
techies_sticky_bomb.lore: Such revolutionary brilliance was meant to be shared.

techies_reactive_tazer.name: Reactive Tazer
techies_reactive_tazer.description: Techies trigger an electric charge giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking Techies are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel. At the end of the effect, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius.
techies_reactive_tazer.lore: A steady bomb hand prefers an abundance of personal space.

techies_suicide.name: Blast Off!
techies_suicide.description: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
techies_suicide.note0: The self-damage Techies receive from this blast is pure and non-lethal.

techies_minefield_sign.name: Minefield Sign
techies_minefield_sign.description: Plant a warning sign, causing mines within its radius to be invulnerable. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts %lifetime% seconds.

techies_land_mines.name: Proximity Mines
techies_land_mines.description: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases up to %outer_damage%%% on the edge. Deals %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.
techies_land_mines.note0: Cannot be placed within %placement_radius% AoE of another Proximity Mine.
techies_land_mines.note1: Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
techies_land_mines.note2: Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
techies_land_mines.note3: Mines are triggered by invisible units.
techies_land_mines.note4: Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
techies_land_mines.note5: Debuff immune units will reveal mines, but not trigger detonation.

marci_grapple.name: Dispose
marci_grapple.description: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.
marci_grapple.lore: Marci excels at removing obstacles from Princess Mirana's path.

marci_companion_run.name: Rebound
marci_companion_run.description: Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.\n\n The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
marci_companion_run.lore: With a friendly or brazen boost, Marci can find her way into the midst of any fight.
marci_companion_run.note1: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.

marci_guardian.name: Sidekick
marci_guardian.description: Marci's loyalty helps ensure survival, imbuing a chosen allied hero and herself with shared lifesteal and attack damage. If Marci and her ally are further apart from each other than %max_partner_distance%, the ally receives no bonuses and Marci only gets %max_partner_penalty%%% until they get close again. Marci's lifesteal also heals her ally and the ally lifesteal also heals Marci.
marci_guardian.note0: Marci cannot cast Sidekick on herself.
marci_guardian.note1: Lifesteal effectiveness gets a %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%% penalty against creeps.
marci_guardian.lore: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.

marci_unleash.name: Unleash
marci_unleash.description: Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.\n\nMarci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
marci_unleash.note0: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
marci_unleash.lore: Though some have sought to understand its origins, Marci rebuffs all attempts to divine the source of her power.

rubick_telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
rubick_telekinesis.description: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
rubick_telekinesis.lore: Even the Grandest Magus may use his powers for enjoyment.
rubick_telekinesis.note0: While the target is in the air, Rubick may use a secondary ability to throw the enemy in a targeted direction.
rubick_telekinesis.note1: When the unit lands, it isn't affected by the area of effect stun.
rubick_telekinesis.land_custom_description: Chooses the location the target will land when Telekinesis finishes.
rubick_telekinesis.land_self_custom_description: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.

rubick_fade_bolt.name: Fade Bolt
rubick_fade_bolt.description: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack damage. Each jump deals less damage.
rubick_fade_bolt.lore: Rubick's favorite spell for dispatching would-be assassins is a rather simple conjuration.

rubick_arcane_supremacy.name: Arcane Supremacy
rubick_arcane_supremacy.description: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and increased potency.
rubick_arcane_supremacy.lore: Not every magus can be a Grand Magus...
rubick_arcane_supremacy.note0: Break disables the gaining of new Arcane Accumulation stacks.
rubick_arcane_supremacy.note1: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing Arcane Accumulation stacks.

rubick_spell_steal.name: Spell Steal
rubick_spell_steal.description:
Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies, and stolen spells last longer on enemies. 
In Arena mode you can steal abilities from your allies.
rubick_spell_steal.lore: ...but even their lesser magics can be a source of much utility.
rubick_spell_steal.note1: Not all abilities can be stolen.

huskar_inner_fire.name: Inner Fire
huskar_inner_fire.description: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.
huskar_inner_fire.lore: Not even Huskar's own flesh can contain the unending expansion of his life force.

huskar_burning_spear.name: Burning Spear
huskar_burning_spear.description: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack.  Multiple attacks will stack additional damage.  Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
huskar_burning_spear.lore: The Sacred Warrior ignites his weaponry after marking it with his own blood - causing far greater pain than he himself feels.
huskar_burning_spear.note0: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target.  There is no cap.
huskar_burning_spear.note1: Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
huskar_burning_spear.note2: Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.

huskar_berserkers_blood.name: Berserker's Blood
huskar_berserkers_blood.description: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
huskar_berserkers_blood.lore: After losing his birthright, Huskar gained a lethality in physical combat that is only heightened as his own blood is spilled.
huskar_berserkers_blood.note0: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than %hp_threshold_max%%% HP.
huskar_berserkers_blood.reverse_custom_description: The higher the health, the stronger the hero. Increases his attack speed, magic resistance and health recovery depending on the current health. Recovery is equal to a share of the hero's agility.

huskar_life_break.name: Life Break
huskar_life_break.description:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune and has 60%% increased magic resistance.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
 In Arena mode, the hero deals 25% Life Break Damage.
huskar_life_break.lore: No matter the danger, Huskar thrusts himself into melees that only he can survive.
huskar_life_break.note0: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
huskar_life_break.note1: Slow works on Spell Immune units.

ursa_earthshock.name: Earthshock
ursa_earthshock.description: Ursa leaps forward %hop_distance% units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for %duration% seconds.
ursa_earthshock.lore: The very steps of a male ursine shake the ground as well as the resolve of opposing warriors.

ursa_overpower.name: Overpower
ursa_overpower.lore: For a behemoth of his size, Ursa is deceptively nimble.
ursa_overpower.description: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.
ursa_overpower.note0: Overpower isn't removed by Black King Bar.
ursa_overpower.note1: Missing an attack still consumes a charge of Overpower.

ursa_fury_swipes.name: Fury Swipes
ursa_fury_swipes.lore: In nature, the wounded rarely survive the attacks of hungry predators.
ursa_fury_swipes.description: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage.  If the same target is not attacked after %bonus_reset_time% seconds, the bonus damage is lost. Max Stacks: %max_stacks%
ursa_fury_swipes.note0: Break disables the application of new stacks.
ursa_fury_swipes.note1: Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

ursa_enrage.name: Enrage
ursa_enrage.lore: Ulfsaar succumbs to his ancient spirit, becoming the most ferocious creature on the battlefield.
ursa_enrage.description: Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

warlock_fatal_bonds.name: Fatal Bonds
warlock_fatal_bonds.description: Binds several enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
warlock_fatal_bonds.lore: An ancient incantation that links the vital energies of multiple lifeforms into one collective body.
warlock_fatal_bonds.note0: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.

warlock_shadow_word.description: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.

warlock_upheaval.description: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% seconds after leaving the area or the spell ends.
warlock_upheaval.lore: Demnok manipulates space-time, impairing entire armies.
warlock_upheaval.note0: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.

warlock_rain_of_chaos.name: Chaotic Offering

warlock_rain_of_chaos.lore: Demnok unleashes the captive spirit in his Dreadwood staff, causing destruction in enemy ranks.
warlock_rain_of_chaos.note0: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.

pangolier_swashbuckle.name: Swashbuckle
pangolier_swashbuckle.description: Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.\n\nLucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
pangolier_swashbuckle.lore: The Pangolier's blade is even nimbler than his tongue.
pangolier_swashbuckle.note1: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.

pangolier_shield_crash.name: Shield Crash
pangolier_shield_crash.description:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position, damaging and slowing all enemies in a radius. For each enemy hero hit, he gains an all damage shield for a short time.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.

 Shield Crash cooldown during Rolling Thunder is decreased.
pangolier_shield_crash.lore: Only in the midst of his enemies does the Pangolier truly thrive.

pangolier_lucky_shot.name: Lucky Shot
pangolier_lucky_shot.description: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.
pangolier_lucky_shot.lore: The Pangolier's blade is guided more often by whim than reason.

pangolier_gyroshell.name: Rolling Thunder
pangolier_gyroshell.description:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% additional magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

 During Rolling Thunder, Shield Crash cooldown is reduced.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
pangolier_gyroshell.lore: Where his ancestors sought only refuge, the Pangolier saw opportunity...
pangolier_gyroshell.note0: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
pangolier_gyroshell.note1: If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
pangolier_gyroshell.stop_custom_lore: Donté Panlin stops when he pleases.

jakiro_dual_breath.name: Dual Breath
jakiro_dual_breath.description: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
jakiro_dual_breath.lore: Pyrexae dragons have tremendously dangerous breath for each branch of the species; combining them is unimaginable.
jakiro_dual_breath.note0: Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
jakiro_dual_breath.note1: Has a %fire_delay% second interval between each breath.
jakiro_dual_breath.note2: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

jakiro_ice_path.name: Ice Path
jakiro_ice_path.description: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
jakiro_ice_path.lore: Jakiro's cunning right head calls upon its frozen heritage, glazing the earth with blistering cold.
jakiro_ice_path.note0: It takes %path_delay% seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
jakiro_ice_path.note1: The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.

jakiro_liquid_fire.name: Liquid Fire
jakiro_liquid_fire.description: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks.
jakiro_liquid_fire.lore: The left maw of Jakiro opens, laying waste to any in its path.
jakiro_liquid_fire.note0: Works on both units and buildings.

jakiro_liquid_ice.name: Liquid Frost
jakiro_liquid_ice.description: Jakiro's attacks chill his enemies, slowing movement for %duration% seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings.

jakiro_macropyre.name: Macropyre
jakiro_macropyre.description: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
jakiro_macropyre.lore: Ice and fire combine to rip the battlefield to shreds with extreme temperatures.
jakiro_macropyre.note0: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for %linger_duration% additional seconds.

zeus_arc_lightning.name: Arc Lightning
zeus_arc_lightning.description: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.
zeus_arc_lightning.lore: Arc Lightning is Zeus' favorite spell to use against puny mortals.

zeus_lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
zeus_lightning_bolt.description: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a %sight_radius_night% radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in %spread_aoe% range.
zeus_lightning_bolt.lore: A shocking punishment for rebellious heathen.
zeus_lightning_bolt.note0: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.

zeus_heavenly_jump.name: Heavenly Jump
zeus_heavenly_jump.description: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets 900 unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

zeus_thundergods_wrath.name: Thundergod's Wrath
zeus_thundergods_wrath.description:
Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage, no matter where they may be.

Thundergod's Wrath also provides True Sight around each hero struck.  If an enemy hero is invisible, it takes no damage, but the True Sight is still created at that hero's location.
zeus_thundergods_wrath.lore: The Lord of Heaven smites all who oppose him, near or far.

kez_echo_slash.name: Echo Slash
kez_echo_slash.description: Kez slashes forward in a line with his Katana, dealing a percentage of his attack damage and a brief slow to targets in the area. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
kez_echo_slash.lore: Kez and his master Kraw have worked tirelessly to train the Kazurai new ways to keep the flyers off balance by improving upon ancient techniques.

kez_grappling_claw.name: Grappling Claw
kez_grappling_claw.description: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
kez_grappling_claw.lore: The speed and agility of the Kazurai allows them to bring down even the highest-flying birds from the sky.

kez_kazurai_katana.name: Kazurai Katana
kez_kazurai_katana.lore: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.
kez_kazurai_katana.description: Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time. Affected enemies have non-stacking reduced health regeneration.

kez_raptor_dance.name: Raptor Dance
kez_raptor_dance.lore: Unleash the inner fury of the Flightless to feast on the essence of your foes.
kez_raptor_dance.description:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable channel for %AbilityChannelTime% second, gaining debuff immunity and %magic_resist%%% magic resistance. If the channel completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt. Kez receives a strong dispel upon completion.
 Deals 25% damage to bosses.

kez_switch_weapons.name: Switch Discipline
kez_switch_weapons.lore: As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.
kez_switch_weapons.description:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Switch Discipline cooldown decreases by %cooldown_reduction_per_level%s per Hero level.

kez_falcon_rush.name: Falcon Rush
kez_falcon_rush.lore: An ancient Shodo technique used to hunt faster aerial foes, stealing the advantage and delivering multiple attacks within a single flap of their prey's panicking wings.
kez_falcon_rush.description: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and an attack rate that is less affected by attack speed.

kez_talon_toss.name: Talon Toss
kez_talon_toss.lore: The Shodo learned to rely upon distance and disorientation to survive against much stronger opposition.
kez_talon_toss.description: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.

kez_shodo_sai.name: Shodo Sai
kez_shodo_sai.lore: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.
kez_shodo_sai.description:
Kez's attacks and abilities with the Sai have a chance to Mark enemies. Marked enemies are slowed, and the next attack or ability damage from Kez gains True Strike and will stun the enemy and deal a critical strike, consuming the buff.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned and Marked, taking additional critical strike and stun when the debuff is triggered.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.

kez_ravens_veil.name: Raven's Veil
kez_ravens_veil.lore: Eying either threat or opportunity, Shodo masters slip instantly into shadow to reset the terms of any engagement in their own favor.
kez_ravens_veil.description: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark with Parry bonus to nearby enemies, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.name: Arctic Burn
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.description:
Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of %percent_damage%%% of their current health each second. 
 Damage from Maximum Health only works at 50% against Creeps.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.lore: The same organ where some dragons stoke their inner flame is, in Auroth, a crucible of unimaginable cold. From deep within her frosty gullet, an exhalation sends enemies into burning agony.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.note0: Enemy units can only receive the Arctic Burn debuff once per cast.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.note2: Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to %attack_point%.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.note3: The damage and slow from Arctic Burn can be dispelled.

winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.name: Splinter Blast
winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.description: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a %split_radius% base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by %movespeed_slow_tooltip%%%.
winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.lore: Produced slowly by specialized vesicles in her frozen gullet, Winter Wyvern blast shards of ice at her enemies.
winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.note0: The primary projectile moves at %projectile_speed% movement speed.
winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.note1: The primary projectile cannot be disjointed and cannot be targeted towards Winter Wyvern herself.

winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.name: Cold Embrace
winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.description: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.lore: From winter's heart comes a cold, healing embrace. The ice slows the blood and allows the spell to better work its curative magic.

winter_wyvern_winters_curse.name: Winter's Curse
winter_wyvern_winters_curse.description: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units.
winter_wyvern_winters_curse.lore: The oldest of the bookwurm's spells, this curse lends truth to the old saw: sometimes the enemy of my enemy is my enemy still.
winter_wyvern_winters_curse.note0: If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
winter_wyvern_winters_curse.note1: Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.

luna_lucent_beam.name: Lucent Beam
luna_lucent_beam.description: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
luna_lucent_beam.lore: Selemene smites those who encroach upon the Nightsilver Woods.

luna_lunar_orbit.name: Lunar Orbit
luna_lunar_orbit.description: Creates %rotating_glaives% glaives that rotate %rotating_glaives_movement_radius% radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.

luna_moon_glaive.name: Moon Glaives
luna_moon_glaive.description: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
luna_moon_glaive.lore: Carefully sharpened, Luna's boomerang-like weapon cuts a wide swath through enemy numbers.
luna_moon_glaive.note0: Moon Glaives do not proc any attack modifier except Critical Strikes.

luna_eclipse.name: Eclipse
luna_eclipse.lore: In times of great need, Selemene herself descends into the world, blocking out the light and hope of the opposed.
luna_eclipse.description: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
luna_eclipse.note0: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
luna_eclipse.note1: Beams will stop if Luna is killed.

axe_berserkers_call.name: Berserker's Call
axe_berserkers_call.description: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
axe_berserkers_call.lore: Mogul Khan's warcry taunts opponents into engaging in an unconquerable battle with the Axe.

axe_battle_hunger.name: Battle Hunger
axe_battle_hunger.description: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The damage is increased by a factor of Axe's armor. The enemy is also slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
axe_battle_hunger.note0: This effect is also removed if a building is destroyed.
axe_battle_hunger.lore: Ordinary heroes cannot withstand Mogul Khan's rage for battle, such that it injures them until it is satisfied.

axe_counter_helix.name: Counter Helix
axe_counter_helix.description: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
axe_counter_helix.note1: Illusions' attacks are not counted toward the trigger when using Aghanim's Scepter.
axe_counter_helix.note0: Triggers upon completion of an attack on the caster.
axe_counter_helix.lore: Axe is the only reinforcement this army needs.

axe_culling_blade.name: Culling Blade
axe_culling_blade.description: Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.
axe_culling_blade.note0: This kill cannot be prevented by abilities like Shallow Grave.
axe_culling_blade.lore: Mogul Khan is the embodiment of battle and fury, launching into a gruesome fatality against those who dare engage the Axe in combat.
